basics.name: Conor Hinchee
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 5+ years of experience building ecommerce applications in React, GraphQL and TypeScript, and analytics in GA4. I've handled on-call rotations and troubleshoot production systems in real time with Google Cloud and TrackJS. Lately I've been building AI harnesses and tools that help developers get work done.

highlights: Led five developers moving search to Google Retail Search, replacing keyword matching with ML-ranked results and raising search-to-purchase conversion.
Own the storefront product carousel. I rebuilt it from scratch with fewer re-renders, which improved Core Web Vitals across the site.
One of four npm maintainers on pure-react-carousel (express-labs), about 67k weekly downloads and 1.7k GitHub stars. I triage issues, review community PRs and publish releases.
Maintained 100% test coverage using React Testing Library and Jest.
Mentored junior engineers through code review and pairing.
Covered on-call rotations, troubleshooting production issues in real time with Google Cloud and TrackJS, leading incident response and writing postmortems.
Solved high-volume support issues on the first call for non-technical customers.

projects.name: Odin, Claude Code Skill
projects.description: A Claude Code skill that runs a coding task through plan, execute, review and sign-off, with a human approval gate between each step. A local dashboard shows a live diff with a written rationale. Anything that took more than one pass becomes a proposed fix to the skill's own rules.

projects.name: heap-analyzer
projects.description: A CLI wrapper around Facebook's memlab that finds memory leaks in Node.js apps. It diffs three heap snapshots and traces what keeps each leaked object alive.
